## Where I am

The SRE take-home exercise is finished and lives in its own private repo `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home`, pushed as a subtree split so only the exercise commits are in its history. It contains a docker-compose stack (flaky-svc built from source, Prometheus, Alertmanager, loadgen), a deliberately broken alert rule, a connection leak under load, and an over-broad IAM policy in Terraform, all with a 3-hour time box and no Kubernetes. A rubric scores four areas 0–3 with no cut-off; Noa is the second reviewer. The `hiring/` folder was removed from the infra branch working tree, and no PR was opened in infra.

- [next-step] Send the exercise to the candidate yourself after the Thursday 4pm Tel Aviv call; add him as a repo collaborator when ready.
- [decision] No Kubernetes at all — 3 hours max, Terraform + compose only (source: t03)
- [decision] Compose must build flaky-svc from source; no prebuilt image (source: t06)
- [decision] Rubric has no pass threshold; panel (Maya + Noa) decides (source: t10)
- [decision] Exercise goes in its own private repo, not the infra repo (source: t12)
- [decision] Do not email the candidate; Maya sends it herself (source: t16)
- [trial-failed] Multi-arch `docker buildx --load` fails ("docker exporter does not currently support exporting manifest lists"); arm64-only build worked for local testing, resolved by building from source in compose.
